request.description: Runs a condition and returns `pass`, `fail` or `unknown` with a per-leaf trace and the configured messages. Facts come from `partyId` (current, non-stale facts) with `facts` overlaid on top, so rules can be tried before data exists. Range facts from bucketed answers pass only when the whole range satisfies the rule, fail when none of it does, and stay `unknown` otherwise. A condition is a tree of `all` / `any` / `not` groups over leaves `{attr, op, value?, pass?, fail?}`. Operators: `eq`, `neq`, `in`, `not_in`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `between` (`{min, max}`), `exists`, `not_exists`, `contains`, `matches`. Limits: depth 10, 200 leaves, 500 list items, 200-character patterns.

response.name: 200 OK
